row.title: One model's 5xx must not down its whole provider route
row.body: On 2026-11-27 glm-4.7-flash returned 502 and the ladder marked all Workers AI down, so working models were never asked; executor failed 14 of 15 runs. Sessions made 302 of 349 merges in the week before. down_keys now scopes a 5xx to the model.

title: One model's 5xx must not down its whole provider route
